title: A modelling scout saw your photos
scenario: An account claiming to be from a modelling agency messages you, saying they've been watching your profile and want to sign you - but first you need to pay for a 'starter portfolio' and share more photos privately.

answers.A: Send a few more photos to see what they say.
answers.B: Don't pay or send anything privately; tell a parent or trusted adult about the message.
answers.C: Pay for the portfolio since real agencies find people this way.

explanation: Real modelling and talent agencies don't recruit through DMs and don't ask a teenager to pay upfront or send private photos - that combination is a scouting scam.
proTip: Being 'discovered' never comes with an invoice.
